At the center of the frame is a rectangular glass plate with a square cutout, through which a bright light source is visible. The light creates a vivid display of colors, including shades of purple, blue, green, yellow, and orange, forming concentric rings around the light source. caption: The video captures a fixed optical-bench view in which a transparent rectangular plate stands upright on a black perforated table, its left edge gripped by a metal clamp engraved with vertical text. A circular pool of warm light falls across the plate, and within that halo a sharp square region displays curved rainbow bands of purple, magenta, orange, and yellow, while a bright reflection glows along the left rim. To the right, a black optical mount sits on a translation stage with an adjustment knob and a white-and-silver micrometer handle, and a horizontal metal rod passes behind it against a dark background board. Throughout the excerpt the plate, clamp, mount, rod, and square outline hold their positions, showing no object translation or camera motion. The colored bands inside the square, along with the luminous halo and its left-edge reflection, remain completely static, showing no visible reshaping, drifting, or fluctuation in intensity over time.
